analyst:
Here is the performance analysis and strategic growth roadmap for **@garvit.irl**.

---

## COMPETITOR RANKING TABLE

*Note: Competitor Engagement Rates are calculated using standard Like-based Engagement Rate $(\text{Avg Likes} / \text{Followers} \times 100)$ to normalize comparison across benchmarked profiles. @garvit.irl’s total ER includes his high comment-to-follower conversion.*

| Handle | Followers | Avg Likes | Eng Rate | Top Content Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **@garvit.irl** | **6,095** | **290.1** | **31.92%** | **Comment-Driven AI Tools & Personal Narrative** |
| **@dhavalkataria_** | 50,768 | 9,256.3 | 18.23% | High-performing lead magnet reels ("Comment CFO/PROOF") |
| **@favourite.engineer** | 157,545 | 9,202.2 | 5.84% | Actionable AI monetization workflows (Claude/NotebookLM) |
| **@aryamanupmanyu** | 74,584 | 2,008.5 | 2.69% | AI Agent build demos + comment automation triggers |
| **@thevarunmayya** | 1,274,928 | 14,306.2 | 1.12% | High-profile tech commentary & podcast clips |
| **@nick_saraev** | 665,471 | 3,716.7 | 0.56% | Curated AI prompt libraries & workflow automation DMs |
| **@arshman** | 375,237 | 2,012.8 | 0.54% | Deep-dive feature breakdowns & tool limitations (Claude) |
| **@vaibhavsisinty** | 2,128,381 | 9,662.3 | 0.45% | Breaking AI news summaries & tech disruption hooks |
| **@ishansharma7390** | 1,271,654 | 4,064.4 | 0.32% | Broad career advice, tech skills, & lifestyle tech content |
| **@nivedan.ai** | 525,277 | 506.1 | 0.10% | Storytelling, TEDx/institutional authority, & milestones |

---

## GROWTH Gaps

1. **Outcome-Oriented Framing (Financial/Utility Hooks)**
   * **The Gap:** Competitors like `@favourite.engineer` (5.84% ER) and `@dhavalkataria_` (18.23% ER) hook users with direct financial or practical outcomes (e.g., *"Claude can pay your rent by building websites"* or *"NotebookLM + YouTube = 🤑"*).
   * **Garvit’s Position:** @garvit.irl’s transcript introduces tools directly (*"stop taking AI subscriptions... free Indian speed AI"*), but lacks the concrete high-value framing that drives mass viral saves and shares.

2. **Standardized Keyword-Triggered Lead Magnets**
   * **The Gap:** Top performers (`@nick_saraev`, `@dhavalkataria_`, `@aryamanupmanyu`) heavily standardize single-word CTA comment triggers (e.g., *"Comment PROMPT"*, *"Comment CFO"*). This feeds algorithmic engagement while leveraging DM automation to capture leads.
   * **Garvit’s Position:** @garvit.irl has a massive comment volume (median 1,655.4 comments), but transcripts show unstandardized CTA prompts, missing out on structured conversion funnels.

3. **Breaking News/Current Event Trendjacking**
   * **The Gap:** Broad tech creators like `@vaibhavsisinty` and `@ishansharma7390` capitalize on immediate news cycles (*"OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra"*, *"Dyson Put A Camera Inside Toothbrushes"*), generating top-of-funnel reach among casual tech enthusiasts.
   * **Garvit’s Position:** Content leans toward broad motivational pieces (e.g., SRK/Ronaldo quotes) or niche tool announcements without hijacking active trending news topics.

---

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (Next 7 Days)

1. **Shift Hook Angle from "Free Tool" to "ROI/Outcome"**
   * **Action:** Re-skin the open-source / free tool video format. Instead of opening with *"Stop taking AI subscriptions right now,"* use a result-oriented hook: *"How to build a $1,000/mo workflow for $0 using open-source API keys."*
   * **Target:** Boost average likes from 290.1 closer to tier-1 competitors (>2,000 likes).

2. **Implement Explicit 1-Word Comment Triggers on Every Video**
   * **Action:** Place a visual overlay and verbal CTA at seconds 3–5 and the end of the video: *"Comment 'SPEED' to get the free GitHub link + setup guide sent to your DMs."*
   * **Target:** Maintain the industry-leading median comment rate (1,655.4) while converting passive viewers into DM automation subscribers.

3. **Publish a "Breaking AI News" Analysis Video**
   * **Action:** Pivot 1 out of 3 weekly videos to breakdown recent industry shifts (e.g., Anthropic/OpenAI updates), modeled after `@vaibhavsisinty`. Use a controversial or clarifying angle: *"The real truth behind [New AI Model/Tool] that no one is telling you."*
   * **Target:** Drive top-of-funnel impression scale beyond current 6,095 follower benchmark.
